g1.label: 1. Famous for its warm ___
g1.why: The text describes the South as famous for its warm climate.

g2.label: 2. The South is the ___ of many kinds of music
g2.why: The text says the South is the home of jazz, blues and country music.

g3.label: 3. Jazz, blues and country music all ___ here
g3.why: The text says these types of music all began in the South.

g4.label: 4. Southern people are known for good ___
g4.why: The text says Southern people are known for their good manners.

g5.label: 5. Showing ___ to others is important
g5.why: The text says showing respect to others is important in Southern culture.

g6.label: 6. A difficult ___
g6.why: The text says the South also has a difficult past.

g7.label: 7. Today, people ___ this history
g7.why: The text says people today remember this history and work for a fairer future.

g8.label: 8. Visitors love the South for its warm ___
g8.why: The text says visitors love the South for its music, food, and warm welcome.

g1.label: 1. New Orleans is a city ___ is famous for jazz
g1.why: ‘Which’ introduces a defining relative clause about a thing (a city), not a person.

g2.label: 2. Louis Armstrong was a musician ___ came from New Orleans
g2.why: ‘Who’ introduces a defining relative clause about a person.

g3.label: 3. Blues is a type of music ___ started in the South
g3.why: ‘Which’ introduces a defining relative clause about a thing (a type of music).

g4.label: 4. The friendly people ___ live in the South
g4.why: ‘Who’ introduces a defining relative clause about people.

g5.label: 5. A person ___ says ‘please’ is polite
g5.why: ‘Who’ introduces a defining relative clause about a person.

g6.label: 6. New Orleans is the place ___ jazz was born
g6.why: ‘Where’ introduces a defining relative clause about a place.

g7.label: 7. My favourite singer is someone ___ grew up in Georgia
g7.why: ‘Who’ introduces a defining relative clause about a person.

g8.label: 8. Gumbo is a dish ___ people eat in the South
g8.why: ‘Which’ introduces a defining relative clause about a thing (a dish).
